subject: Career
title: LinkedIn: The Professional Homepage
description: A short lesson to help you apply LinkedIn: The Professional Homepage.

hook.text: 97% of recruiters use LinkedIn. If your profile is empty, you're invisible.

buildup.text: Your headline, summary, and experience form a mini-pitch that runs 24/7.

discovery.text: Profiles with professional photos get 14x more views. Custom headlines get 5x more connection requests.

twist.text: Most people list job duties. Winners list achievements with numbers and outcomes.

climax.text: Treat your LinkedIn like a landing page: clear headline, compelling summary, proof of results.

punchline.text: Your LinkedIn works while you sleep. Make it say the right things.

quiz.question: What percentage of recruiters use LinkedIn?

details.summary: LinkedIn functions as your professional homepage, often being the first search result for your name. Optimizing your profile with a clear headline, compelling summary, and consistent branding ensures you make the right first impression on anyone who searches for you.
details.whyItMatters: Recruiters and hiring managers check LinkedIn before making contact decisions. An unoptimized profile costs opportunities you never know you missed.
takeaways: Your headline should describe your value, not just your job title
The summary section is prime real estate for your brand narrative
A professional photo increases profile views by up to fourteen times

faq.question: What should a LinkedIn headline include beyond your current job title?
faq.answer: Describe the value you provide and for whom. Instead of 'Marketing Manager at Company X,' try 'Helping B2B SaaS companies turn content into pipeline.' The headline is searchable and shows up everywhere your name appears on the platform.

faq.question: How often should you update your LinkedIn profile?
faq.answer: Review and refresh your profile quarterly. Update it immediately after major accomplishments, role changes, or new skills. Regular activity signals to the algorithm and your network that you are engaged, which increases your visibility in search and feeds.
